chapter: Carey band, jazz and drum demonstrations
title: Origin of blowing the drum with Punch Miller at 3rd and Franklin
summary: He and Punch Miller, in Jack Carey's band, hit on the trick in a barroom on the way from National Park in 1919; the park held dances at night after ballgames.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
